source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
As your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase) begins, 1 **PSYKER** that has this ability may use it: pick 1 enemy unit that this **PSYKER** can see and that is within 12" of it, then roll 1 D6.

- On a 1, D3 **[mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds)** are inflicted on that **PSYKER**’s unit.
- On a 2+, until your next [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase) starts, attacks that target that enemy unit get their Armour Penetration characteristic improved by 1.
